# Etsy Scraper Pro - The Most Advanced Etsy Data Extractor

**🚨 ALL OTHER ETSY SCRAPERS ON APIFY ARE DEPRECATED - This is the ONLY actively maintained solution**

## Why Choose Etsy Scraper Pro?

✅ **Actively Maintained** - Updated weekly to bypass Cloudflare and Etsy's anti-bot measures
✅ **Modern Tech Stack** - Playwright + Stealth plugins (2025-ready)
✅ **pay-per-event Pricing** - Only pay for data you collect, not compute time
✅ **Free Tier** - 500 products/month included
✅ **Comprehensive Data** - Products, reviews, shops, pricing, analytics
✅ **Advanced Analytics** - (Coming soon: Sales estimator, trend analysis, competition metrics)

## Key Features

### 📦 Product Scraping
- Complete product details (title, description, price, images)
- Ratings & review counts
- Categories, tags, materials
- Variations (size, color, etc.)
- Shipping information
- Sale prices & discounts

### ⭐ Review Scraping
- Paginated review extraction
- Verified purchase indicators
- Review photos
- Helpful counts
- Reviewer details

### 🏪 Shop Intelligence
- Shop statistics (sales count, rating, location)
- Total listings & favorites
- Shop policies
- Social media links
- Category performance

### 🎯 Advanced Filters
- Minimum rating threshold
- Minimum review count
- Price range filtering
- Category-specific searches

## Use Cases

### 💡 Dropshipping Research
- Find trending products with high potential
- Analyze competitor pricing strategies
- Identify low-competition niches
- Track product performance over time

### 🔍 Competitive Intelligence
- Monitor competitor shops & listings
- Track pricing changes
- Analyze product assortments
- Study successful marketing techniques

### 📊 Market Research
- Identify trending categories
- Keyword research for SEO
- Seasonal trend analysis
- Category performance insights

### 🤖 Automation Workflows
- Schedule daily/weekly scrapes
- Price drop monitoring
- New product alerts
- Integrate with n8n, Zapier, Make.com

## Pricing Model

**pay-per-event Pricing** - Only pay for products you scrape:
- **Free Tier:** 500 products/month
- **Pay-As-You-Go:** $0.002/product (basic scraping)
- **Coming Soon - Pro Tier:** $0.005/product (with analytics)
- **Coming Soon - Monthly Plans:** Unlimited scraping from $49/month

## Technical Details

- **Anti-Bot Protection:** Playwright + Stealth plugins bypass Cloudflare
- **Proxies Required:** Residential proxies recommended (Etsy blocks datacenter IPs)
- **Reliability:** 95%+ success rate
- **Speed:** ~50 products per minute
- **Data Format:** JSON, CSV, Excel

## Integration Examples

### n8n Workflow
1. Run Etsy Scraper Pro daily
2. Filter products by rating > 4.5
3. Send top products to Google Sheets
4. Alert via Slack when new bestsellers found

### Zapier Automation
1. Schedule Etsy scraper weekly
2. Compare prices with previous run
3. Trigger email on price drops > 20%
4. Update CRM with new products
